title: Unit 9 Reading App — Up, Down, and All Around! + Skateboarding
subtitle: Landing screen → 📘 Student Book (roller coasters: vocab + paragraph-gated reading + strategy + questions + force chart + quiz) · 📒 Workbook (The Science of Skateboarding: vocab + reading + T/F + cause & effect + quiz). 11 modules total.

content: Read the roller-coaster passage in paragraph pairs, each pair unlocked by its comprehension question (LP p.306).
Practice the Understand Cause and Effect strategy with the signal words because, why and as a result.
Answer the four comprehension questions from SB p.157 Activity 1.
Match each force to when you feel it on a roller coaster and on a bicycle (SB p.157 Activity 2).
Read The Science of Skateboarding and complete the workbook's own cause-and-effect chart (WB p.113 Activity 4).
Score at least 80% on the 10-question Student Book quiz and the 6-question Workbook quiz.
language: Recognize the cause-and-effect signal words: because, why, as a result.
Use the academic word describe to talk about a roller-coaster ride.
Read the content words in context: safety bar, steep, centripetal force, inertia, experience.
Read the workbook words in context: deck, truck, nose, tail, curve, wheel.
